## Lexical structure

Chapter: [Lexical structure](../language/lexical-structure.md).

[Identifiers](../language/lexical-structure.md#identifiers):

```text
IDENTIFIER_OR_KEYWORD ->
    ( ASCII_LETTER | `_` ) ( ASCII_LETTER | ASCII_DIGIT | `_` )*
IDENTIFIER -> IDENTIFIER_OR_KEYWORD except STRICT_KEYWORD
ASCII_LETTER -> [`a`-`z`] | [`A`-`Z`]
ASCII_DIGIT -> [`0`-`9`]
```

[Keywords](../language/lexical-structure.md#keywords):

```text
STRICT_KEYWORD -> `abstract` | `as` | `domain` | `else` | `false` | `fn`
    | `for` | `generic` | `if` | `let` | `loop` | `method` | `mut` | `pack`
    | `requires` | `return` | `subtype` | `true` | `type` | `unpack` | `while`
```

[Integer literals](../language/lexical-structure.md#integer-literals):

```text
INTEGER_LITERAL -> ASCII_DIGIT+
```

[Other literals](../language/lexical-structure.md#other-literals):

```text
FLOAT_LITERAL -> DECIMAL_FLOAT | HEX_FLOAT
DECIMAL_FLOAT -> ASCII_DIGIT+ `.` ASCII_DIGIT* EXPONENT?
    | ASCII_DIGIT+ EXPONENT
    | `.` ASCII_DIGIT+ EXPONENT?
EXPONENT -> ( `e` | `E` ) ( `+` | `-` )? ASCII_DIGIT+
HEX_FLOAT -> ( `0x` | `0X` ) ( HEX_DIGIT+ ( `.` HEX_DIGIT* )? | `.` HEX_DIGIT+ )
    ( `p` | `P` ) ( `+` | `-` )? ASCII_DIGIT+
HEX_DIGIT -> ASCII_DIGIT | [`a`-`f`] | [`A`-`F`]
```

[Punctuation](../language/lexical-structure.md#punctuation):

```text
PUNCTUATION -> `+` | `-` | `*` | `!` | `&&` | `||`
    | `==` | `!=` | `<` | `<=` | `>` | `>=`
    | `->` | `::` | `<:`
    | `(` | `)` | `{` | `}` | `[` | `]`
    | `,` | `:` | `;` | `=` | `.` | `^`
```

## Expressions

Chapter: [Expressions](../language/expressions.md).

```text
Expression -> LiteralExpression | UnitExpression | PathExpression
    | GroupedExpression | BlockExpression | IfExpression | CallExpression
    | OperatorExpression | LambdaExpression | PackExpression
```

[Literal expressions](../language/expressions.md#literal-expressions):

```text
LiteralExpression -> INTEGER_LITERAL | `true` | `false`
UnitExpression -> `(` `)`
```

[Path expressions](../language/expressions.md#path-expressions):

```text
PathExpression -> IDENTIFIER ( `::` PathSegment )*
    | `generic` ( `::` PathSegment )+
```

[Grouped expressions](../language/expressions.md#grouped-expressions):

```text
GroupedExpression -> `(` Expression `)`
```

[Block expressions](../language/expressions.md#block-expressions):

```text
BlockExpression -> `{` Statement* Expression? `}`
```

[`if` expressions](../language/expressions.md#if-expressions):

```text
IfExpression ->
    `if` Expression BlockExpression `else` ( BlockExpression | IfExpression )
```

[Call expressions](../language/expressions.md#call-expressions):

```text
CallExpression -> Expression `(` CallArguments? `)`
CallArguments -> Expression ( `,` Expression )* `,`?
```

[Operator expressions](../language/expressions.md#operator-expressions):

```text
OperatorExpression -> UnaryOperator Expression
    | Expression BinaryOperator Expression
UnaryOperator -> `-` | `!`
BinaryOperator -> `*` | `+` | `-` | `==` | `!=` | `<` | `<=` | `>` | `>=`
    | `&&` | `||`
```

[Lambda expressions](../language/expressions.md#lambda-expressions):

```text
LambdaExpression -> `fn` `(` FunctionParameters? `)` `->` Type BlockExpression
```

[Pack expressions](../language/expressions.md#pack-expressions):

```text
PackExpression ->
    `pack` `{` `scheme` `:` Expression `,` `point` `:` Expression `,`? `}`
    | `pack` Type `{` `witness` `:` Expression `,`
      `fields` `:` `[` PackFields? `]` `,`? `}`
PackFields -> Expression ( `,` Expression )* `,`?
```

```text
ScaleRow -> `(` ( ScaleMonomial ( `,` ScaleMonomial )* `,`? )? `)`
ScaleMonomial -> `-`? ScaleFactor ( `*` ScaleFactor )*
ScaleFactor -> INTEGER_LITERAL | Fraction | Path ( `^` `-`? INTEGER_LITERAL )?
CoordinateScale -> CoordinateName `:` Path
```

## Resource programs

Chapter: [Resource programs](../storage/resource-programs.md).

[Resource functions](../storage/resource-programs.md#resource-functions):

```text

ResourceParameter -> IDENTIFIER `:`
    ( ScalarType | OwnedType | BorrowedType | RuntimeParameterType | NumericalParameterType )

ResourceResult -> IDENTIFIER `:` ( OwnedType | NumericalResultType )
```

[Storage types](../storage/resource-programs.md#storage-types):

```text
BorrowedType -> ( `Read` | `Write` | `ReadWrite` )
    `<` ElementType `,` INTEGER_LITERAL `,` INTEGER_LITERAL `>` `initializes`?
ElementType -> `F64` | `Complex` `<` `F64` `>`
Layouts -> Layout ( `,` Layout )* `,`?
Layout -> `layout` `(` INTEGER_LITERAL `,` INTEGER_LITERAL `,` INTEGER_LITERAL `,`
    INTEGER_LITERAL `,` ( `true` | `false` ) `)`
```

[Resource statements](../storage/resource-programs.md#resource-statements):

```text
ResourceStatement -> StorageStatement `;` | BorrowStatement | ValueStatement
    | ResourceCall | ResourceBranch | RuntimeStatement `;` | NumericalStatement
StorageStatement -> `allocate` IDENTIFIER `:` ElementType `[` INTEGER_LITERAL `]`
    | `move` IDENTIFIER `->` IDENTIFIER

    | `release` `(` IDENTIFIER `)`
    | `transpose` `(` IDENTIFIER `)`
    | `fill` `(` IDENTIFIER `,` Payload `)`
    | `store` `(` IDENTIFIER `,` INTEGER_LITERAL `,` INTEGER_LITERAL `,` Payload `)`
    | `expect` `(` IDENTIFIER `,` INTEGER_LITERAL `,` INTEGER_LITERAL `,` Payload `)`
    | `copy` `(` IDENTIFIER `,` IDENTIFIER `)`
BorrowStatement -> `borrow` IDENTIFIER `=` AccessMode `(` IDENTIFIER ( `,` Layout )? `)` `;`
AccessMode -> `read` | `write` | `read_write`
```

[Payloads](../storage/resource-programs.md#payloads):

```text

Real -> ( `+` | `-` )? ( INTEGER_LITERAL | FLOAT_LITERAL )
```

[Scalar values and calls](../storage/resource-programs.md#scalar-values-and-calls):

```text
ResourceArguments -> IDENTIFIER ( `,` IDENTIFIER )* `,`?
```

[Runtime maps](../storage/resource-programs.md#runtime-maps):
